title: Protocol for cell-based screening assay to measure ERK1/2 phosphorylation as a readout for complement receptor activation
protocol: Empty 50 mL of buffy coat blood into a square 100 mm Sterilin dish.
Add 50 mL DPBS (1:1 dilution with blood), swirl to mix.
Add 15 mL Lymphoprep to each of four 50 mL SepMate PBMC Isolation Tubes.
Gently layer 25 mL of blood/PBS mix onto Lymphoprep.
Centrifuge at 800 × g for 30 minutes at 20°C–25°C with deceleration set to “Off” or “Slow”.
Remove the top plasma layer (∼12 mL) and discard carefully.
Transfer and combine the PBMC layers from 4 SepMate tubes into two sterile 50 mL conical tubes.
Add ice-cold cell culture water up to the 45 mL mark in each tube, invert to mix continuously for 1 minute.
Quickly add 5 mL cold 10× DPBS to restore tonicity.
Centrifuge at 800 × g for 10 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Carefully pour off supernatant and discard.
Repeat the previous steps until no more red blood cells are visible in the pellet.
Isolate CD14+ monocytes using magnetic separation.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 2.5 mL cold Separation Buffer by gently pipetting up and down.
Combine the resuspended cell pellets (5 mL total).
Pass the combined cells through a cell strainer placed over a 50 mL conical tube.
Add an additional 10 mL Separation buffer to wash the filter for maximum cell recovery.
Count cells using a hemacytometer or automatic cell counter.
Determine the required volumes of separation buffer and CD14 microbeads based on total cell number.
Centrifuge cells at 800 x g for 6 minutes at 20°C-25°C.
Resuspend the cell pellet in calculated volume of separation buffer.
Add the required volume of CD14 microbeads to the cell solution under dimmed lighting.
Cover the cell tubes with aluminum foil and incubate at 4°C for 15 minutes.
Insert an LS column into a MACS separator.
Ensure the column is vertical and pushed in all the way.
Incubate for 15 minutes.
Add 30 mL of Separation Buffer to the conical tube containing labeled cells.
Gently pipette up and down to wash the cells.
Centrifuge cells at 800 × g at 20°C–25°C for 5 minutes.
Prime the LS column using 3 mL of separation buffer.
Resuspend the cell pellet in Separation Buffer (500 μL per 10^8 cells based on counting results).
Pass the cell solution through a 40 μm cell strainer to remove any clumps.
Load the cell solution into the LS column.
Pellet the cells by centrifuging at 800 × g for 5 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Resuspend cells at a concentration of approximately 1.2 × 10^6/mL in complete IMDM medium supplemented with 10% FBS, 1% penicillin/streptomycin, and 15 ng/mL rhM-CSF.
Add the cell solution to sterile 100 mm square Petri dishes at a volume of 12 mL per dish.
Transfer the dishes to a cell culture incubator set at 37°C with 5% CO2 and culture for 7 days.
If the culture medium becomes visibly acidic between day 5 and day 7, add 3 mL of fresh complete medium containing 15 ng/mL rhM-CSF per dish.
Harvest cells when most attach to the plate, which is typically between Day 5 and Day 7 post-seeding.
Aspirate the medium containing non-adherent cells upon differentiation of HMDMs.
Gently add DPBS (5 mL/dish) to wash adherent macrophages.
Remove DPBS and add 5 mL/dish complete IMDM medium without rhM-CSF.
Lift adherent cells using a cell scraper gently.
Transfer the cell suspension into a sterile 50 mL conical tube.
Add an additional 5 mL of complete IMDM medium to wash residual cells off the dish.
Mix the cell solution by pipetting up and down.
Perform a cell count using a hemacytometer or automatic cell counter.
Maintain CHO-C5aR1 and CHO-C3aR cells in complete Ham’s F-12 medium supplemented with 10% FBS, 1% P/S, and 400 μg/mL G418.
Passage the cells when they reach 80%-90% confluency by performing a 1:5 passage every two days or a 1:10 passage every three days.
Remove cell medium from T75 flask by aspirating.
Add 4 mL DPBS to gently wash the cells, then discard.
Add 4 mL of 0.05% Trypsin-EDTA.
Incubate the flask at 20°C–25°C for 5 minutes to detach the cells.
After incubation, add 6 mL of complete F-12 medium to neutralize the trypsin.
Transfer 2 mL of the cell mixture to a new T75 flask containing 10 mL fresh F-12 medium (i.e., 1:5 split).
Discard or seed the remaining (8 mL) cell solution into microplates for assays as needed.
Perform a cell count using a hemacytometer or automated cell counter.
Pellet the cells by centrifugation at 400 × g for 5 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Resuspend the cell pellet in complete F-12 medium (for CHO cells) or complete IMDM medium supplemented with 15 ng/mL rhM-CSF (for HMDMs).
Transfer 100 μL of resuspended cells per well into a tissue-treated clear-bottom 96-well plate.
Incubate the plates at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 24 hours to allow cell settling.
Starve cells by removing medium and replacing with serum-free medium.
Remove the complete culture medium from the cells using a multichannel pipette or vacuum aspirator.
Add 100 μL per well of serum-free IMDM for HMDMs or F-12 for CHO-C5aR1/C3aR.
Incubate at 37°C/5% CO2 for 8–16 hours.
Determine the suitable agonist or antagonist to be used for the assay.
Perform a counter-screen of potential hits for human C5aR1 against human C3aR.
Perform a counter-screen of potential hits for human C3aR against human C5aR.
Verify in HMDMs whether the induced ERK signaling is driven through the receptor of interest, such as C5aR1 or C3aR.
Warm up the dilution buffer for CHO cells: serum-free F-12 + 0.1% BSA.
Warm up the dilution buffer for HMDMs: IMDM + 0.1% BSA.
Prepare all ligands at the final concentration to be added to the cells.
For a 96-well plate, prepare triplicates of 50 μL/well.
Prepare at least 180 μL per concentration/condition considering dead volume.
If required, prepare serial dilutions for test ligands starting with a working solution of 10 μM as the highest concentration.
Serially dilute 1/10 by transferring 20 μL of ligand solution to 180 μL of diluent for the next concentration.
Pipette up and down to mix well following each transfer.
Transfer all dilutions into a 96-well polypropylene V-bottom source plate.
Pre-treat cells with antagonists if applicable.
Take out the cell plate from the incubator.
Gently remove serum-free medium using a vacuum aspirator or multichannel pipette, avoiding contact with the cell monolayer.
Add 45 μL/well of known inhibitor or testing compound into the cell plate using a manual or electronic multichannel pipettor.
Return the plate to the tissue culture incubator and incubate at 37°C for 30 min.
Stimulate cells with agonists.
For an inhibition assay, add 5 μL/well of 10 X agonist (C5a or C3a) directly to the cells without removing pretreatment solution.
For agonist assay, use a vacuum aspirator or multichannel pipette to gently remove serum-free medium from cells.
Transfer 50 μL/well of testing agonist solution to cells.
Return cell plate to incubator (37°C, 5% CO2) and incubate for 10 min (stimulation).
Prepare 1 X Ultra lysis buffer by mixing 1 part of 5 X Ultra lysis buffer with 4 volumes of deionized water, invert to mix.
Remove ligand treatment solution using a multichannel pipette or vacuum aspirator upon 10 min stimulation.
Add 50 μL/well of 1× lysis buffer to cells.
Place the plate on an orbital shaker and shake for 15 min (450 rpm, 20°C–25°C).
Thaw the cell lysate by gently shaking the plate on an orbital shaker if frozen.
Ensure all samples have been completely thawed and warmed to 20°C–25°C before commencing detection.
Calculate the volume of the reaction mixes (2.5 μL per sample) needed for the assay.
Determine the required volumes as: Volume of acceptor / donor mix required = Number of wells (samples) × 2.5 μl × 110% (to allow for dead volume).
Prepare AlphaLISA acceptor and donor mixes under dimmed lighting.
Transfer 5 μl of cell lysate from each well of the 96-well cell plate to a 384-well ProxiPlate using a multichannel pipette.
Add negative control (1× lysis buffer only) in triplicates to the ProxiPlate.
Add positive control (phospho-ERK positive control lysate) in triplicates to the ProxiPlate.
Add 2.5 μL/well of Acceptor mix.
Add 2.5 μL/well of Donor mix.
Gently tap the plate to ensure proper mixing.
Seal the plate with TopSeal-A plate seal.
Cover the sealed plate with aluminum foil to protect from light.
Incubate the plate for at least 2 h (up to 16 h) at 20°C–25°C.
Place the plate in an Alpha-capable plate reader without removing the TopSeal-A film.
Allow the plate to equilibrate to the plate reader temperature for at least 5 min prior to reading.
Read the plate using standard AlphaLISA settings.
